title: OpenPrime / Overview
description: Rate, errors and latency for every OpenPrime service, plus workload health and error logs.

panels.title: API requests/s
panels.description: Request rate on the backend API, all routes.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", service="openprime-app-backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: API availability
panels.description: Share of backend API requests in the selected time range that did not return a 5xx.

targets.expr: 1 - ((sum(increase(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", service="openprime-app-backend", status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", service="openprime-app-backend"}[$__range])) > 0))

panels.title: API p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile backend API request duration.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", service="openprime-app-backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Generate success rate
panels.description: Generate jobs that succeeded, out of those that finished (succeeded or failed), in the selected time range. Retried attempts are not finished.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(openprime_jobs_total{namespace="$namespace", type="generate", outcome="succeeded"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(openprime_jobs_total{namespace="$namespace", type="generate", outcome=~"succeeded|failed"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Metrics targets down
panels.description: Scrape targets (pods behind a metrics port) Prometheus cannot reach right now.

targets.expr: count(up{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", endpoint="metrics"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: New users
panels.description: People who used OpenPrime for the first time (the backend created their user record). Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "User synced" | json | __error__="" | message="User synced" | created="true" [$__range]))

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: People who did something that changes data in the selected range: signed in for the first time, or created, edited or deleted an environment or a cloud credential. Browsing alone is not logged, so it does not count. Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: count(sum by (userId) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "userId" | json | __error__="" | userId!="" | message=~"User synced|Environment (created|updated|deleted)|Credential (created|updated|deleted)" [$__range])))

panels.title: Environments created
panels.description: Environments created in the selected range. Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "Environment created" | json | __error__="" | message="Environment created" | userId!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Environments updated
panels.description: Environment edits saved in the selected range. Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "Environment updated" | json | __error__="" | message="Environment updated" | userId!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Environments deleted
panels.description: Environments deleted in the selected range. Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "Environment deleted" | json | __error__="" | message="Environment deleted" | userId!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Cloud credentials added
panels.description: Cloud credentials saved in the selected range (only keys AWS accepts are saved). Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "Credential created" | json | __error__="" | message="Credential created" | userId!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Generate requests
panels.description: Infrastructure generations queued in the selected range; outcomes are on the Jobs & AI dashboard. Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "Job enqueued" | json | __error__="" | message="Job enqueued" | type="generate" [$__range]))

panels.title: Push requests
panels.description: Pushes to a Git repository queued in the selected range; outcomes are on the Jobs & AI dashboard. Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "Job enqueued" | json | __error__="" | message="Job enqueued" | type="push" [$__range]))

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: People who did something that changes data in the selected range: signed in for the first time, or created, edited or deleted an environment or a cloud credential. Browsing alone is not logged, so it does not count. Distinct people per time bucket.

targets.expr: count(sum by (userId) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "userId" | json | __error__="" | userId!="" | message=~"User synced|Environment (created|updated|deleted)|Credential (created|updated|deleted)" [$__interval]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: New users
panels.description: First-time OpenPrime users per time bucket. Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "User synced" | json | __error__="" | message="User synced" | created="true" [$__interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Environments created
panels.description: Environments created per time bucket. Counted from the backend's logs in Loki, one log line per event.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", container="openprime-app-backend"} |= "Environment created" | json | __error__="" | message="Environment created" | userId!="" [$__interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second, by service. Probe traffic is excluded at the source.

targets.expr: sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 5xx error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx, by service.

targets.expr: (sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration, by service.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in the selected time range, by container. Any non-zero value is worth a look; a climbing one is a crashloop.

targets.expr: sum by (container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", container=~"$service"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Available replicas
panels.description: Ready replicas per Deployment.

targets.expr: sum by (deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"$service"})

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Requests per second across the selected services, by status class.

targets.expr: sum by (class) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]), "class", "${1}xx", "status_code", "([0-9])[0-9][0-9]"))

panels.title: Error logs
panels.description: Log lines at level error from the selected services (structured JSON logs, labelled by Promtail).

targets.expr: {namespace="$namespace", container=~"$service", level="error"}
